method: Built-in image_gen via imagegen skill, five distinct text-free decorative scenes; no CLI/API fallback.
assetFormat: WebP quality 82, 1024x1536; original generated images retained.

assets.name: opportunity
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: text-free decorative bitmap for one compact portrait curriculum phase card on a premium professional AI-product learning website.
Primary request: one minimal frosted-white 3D still life, not a UI screenshot or collage.
Canvas: portrait 2:3, intended 1024x1536. Gentle white studio floor and near-white air, subtle phase tint, soft diffuse daylight, soft-focus depth, restrained physical materials and natural light shadows.
Composition: existing dense HTML heading and three bullets will occupy the TOP and LEFT. Keep the top 55% and the left 65% very bright quiet near-white. Group only a few small theme objects in the LOWER RIGHT, predominantly x=65-96%, y=60-95%. The sculpture should be visibly richer than a plain gradient but small, very pale and subordinate to the readable overlaid text. No broad dark shadow under the text region. No central giant object. Fill canvas edge to edge; no card border or frame.
Series style: matte ivory and translucent frosted glass, gently rounded forms, white-on-white highlights, light pastel edges, airy uncluttered product-editorial art. A coherent visual series matching a white/lavender SaaS course homepage; no noisy gloss, heavy glow or saturated backdrop.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numerals, readable marks, UI, screenshot, logo, watermark, buttons, square icon tiles, arrows connecting cards, people, faces, data chart, statistics, money/coins, income claims, trophies, certificates, real brand/payment marks. These images are backgrounds only, never new course content.
Subject: Phase: product and opportunity discovery. Pale lavender. A small frosted lavender lightbulb-shaped idea sculpture resting beside two tiny blank ivory rounded note sheets. An airy exploratory still life, not an icon inside a tile. Cluster lower-right; quiet bright-white top and left.
